svg.title: Finally the origin slope and gap are consequences of the actual score expansion. The quadratic line limit is one half of the signed average of P □[pdirect∥dz∥2 + ∥llinz∥2] plus one half of the penalty times the squared linear prediction residuals. Cubic and quartic terms start in their re- spective orders. Analytic Taylor expansion therefore gives zero first derivative at zero and this quadratic form as the Hessian. Restrict to vertical vectors. Keeping the identity signed orienta- tion gives coefficients b = pdirect/|Signed| and ppenalty in front of the curl and prediction-residual energies. The forest counting estimate reconstructs a vertical field from these energies, with loss K = curlFactor(L, box, linkCost)+probeFactor(L). Its tree edges vanish; the harness link estimate bounds the remaining reconstructed links. Hence
